title: Coral and the Typewriter
author: Beatrix Quintana
blurb: Sable Whitlock, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
